caption.hook: To forge a blade that never breaks, you must first anchor your roots in the dark.
caption.body:
Walking through the winding alleys of Lisbon under the nocturnal glow, you feel the city transforming into a giant blacksmith's hearth. Sparks fly from the tram tracks, but here, on this quiet corner, the sign reminds us of our anchor: 'Roots.' 

In the spirit of the Book of Earth, Miyamoto Musashi teaches us that a warrior must build a foundation so solid that no storm can shake it. Like Roronoa Zoro tempering his swords through sheer willpower, we must forge our creative vision from the ground up. This shot captures that silent, illuminated anchor holding steady amidst the rush. We find our flow not by running from the fire, but by letting it refine our essence. Your art is only as strong as the roots you cultivate.
